description: This file implements the core functions for a server object in the SLAP framework, specifically handling page execution and transfer commands within the Bmc2 server component. It defines functions to execute or transfer control to a specified page path by preparing parameter lists and invoking a controller's command addition method.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapBmc2SrvoExecute(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * page_path)
methods.description: Handles the execution of a specified page by preparing a parameter list and instructing the controller to execute the page.

parameters.name: hThisObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the server object itself.

parameters.name: page_path
parameters.description: Path of the page to execute.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapBmc2SrvoTransfer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * page_path)
methods.description: Transfers control to a specified page, ending the current execution context, by preparing a parameter list and instructing the controller to transfer control.

parameters.name: hThisObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the server object itself.

parameters.name: page_path
parameters.description: Path of the page to transfer control to.
